claims.text: The Assembly's programme schedules the meeting of the Elected Representatives convened by the Interim Speaker for 18/12/2017 at 10:00 am. Its order of business includes the election of the Prime Minister Designate by secret ballot, a tally by the Chief Clerk and the Auditor General, and the Interim Speaker's declaration of the result.
claims.uncertainty: A programme published before the meeting. It records no result.
